endorsements.quote: Integration should enable warm handoffs to human services, countering the risks of self-rationing and self-medication behaviors described above.

Safety and equity audits should specifically target triage failures, and unless or until an established threshold of accurate triage is met, the use of ChatGPT Health should be avoided for such purposes entirely.

Transparency about model capabilities and limits helps users recognize when chatbot guidance is insufficient, which may mitigate the risks of uncritical acceptance of outputs, and performance evaluations should center on reductions in unmet needs and improved access rather than engagement metrics.

unlisted_practices: Embed consumer LLM health tools in public and clinical infrastructures as a complement to, not a substitute for, human care.
Prioritize augmentation of clinicians and care teams rather than shifting the burden to patients when deploying LLM health tools.
Evaluate consumer health AI performance by reductions in unmet needs and improved access rather than engagement metrics.
Adopt solidarity-based data governance that strengthens collective oversight and assesses data uses by public value versus grave risks.
Provide accessible remedies, such as harm mitigation bodies, for people harmed by health data use.
Require that a portion of commercial gains from consumer health AI be returned to the public domain, for example through data access levies.
Expand democratic participation in governance of consumer health AI, for example through citizens' juries.
Rebuild institutional conditions of accessibility and affordability of health care so that reliance on chatbots as a last resort is unnecessary.
